title: Three Games · 三合一神作合集 (Saltline / 钟表匠 / Tidewright)
summary: Felix Rieseberg 发布的传奇合集：包含 Saltline、钟表匠之心与 Tidewright 三款零人工反馈初稿作品。
summaryEn: Legendary trilogy published by Felix Rieseberg featuring Saltline, The Clockmaker's Heart and Tidewright.
description: 这是 Fable 5.2 发布首日转发量最高的神作合集。作者署名写道：'所有游戏均由 Claude Fable 5.2 独立端到端制作，纯第一版初稿，无任何人类反馈修正'。在一个页面中汇聚了三种截然不同的游戏类型与视觉风格。
descriptionEn: The most widely shared showcase on launch day. Signed by Felix Rieseberg: 'All games made with Claude Fable 5.2. First drafts, no human feedback.' Houses three distinct genres in a unified experience.
features: 汇聚 Saltline、钟表匠之心、Tidewright 三款标志性 AI 独立游戏
零人工调试、纯 LLM 第一初稿端到端生成
涵盖第一人称射击、机械钟表解谜与海洋潮汐生存三大玩法
集成极简切换界面与独立 WebGL 渲染管线
featuresEn: Houses three iconic AI games: Saltline, The Clockmaker's Heart, and Tidewright
100% pure first-draft generation with zero human touch or code editing
Seamlessly spans FPS, clockwork mechanical puzzle, and tidal ocean survival
Unified switching interface with dedicated WebGL rendering pipelines

controls.action: 角色移动 / 控制
瞄准视角 / 互动点击
快速切换对应游戏
跳跃 / 确认操作

title: Mirror Earth · 镜像地球 (实时天气全境破坏模拟)
summary: 以整个真实地球为沙盒：全境地表可自由穿梭与摧毁，天气数据与现实世界全球实时同步。
summaryEn: The entire planet modeled as an interactive destructible sandbox, synced with real-time global weather.
description: Matt Shumer 借助 Claude Fable 5.2 构建的震撼项目。将整个地球数字化为可破坏的 3D 游戏世界，不仅能够自由缩放穿梭至各大洲各个城市，更有实时天气 API 驱动动态云层与降水，伴随震撼的全境物理破坏粒子效果。
descriptionEn: A jaw-dropping achievement by Matt Shumer via Claude Fable 5.2. Turns the globe into an open destructible voxel world synced with live Earth weather data and high-yield volumetric physics destruction.
features: 全地球尺度自由漫游缩放与地表无缝穿梭
现实全球天气 API 实时驱动全球云系与气象变化
地表建筑物与地形完全可受物理撞击摧毁
多玩家房间联机与共享空间同步
featuresEn: Global planetary scale with seamless zooming from orbit to ground level
Live meteorological APIs powering real-time global cloud and storm fronts
100% destructible surface geography and urban structures
Multiplayer room support for shared planetary exploration

controls.action: 高空漫游飞行与水平机动
从近地视角平滑缩放至太空轨道
释放动能炮引发局部地表破坏
加速冲刺飞行

title: Voxel Engine · 纯原生 3D 体素方块沙盒
summary: 由 Fable 5.2 生成的纯网页体素渲染引擎，支持程序化地形生成、动态光照与实时方块搭建拆除。
summaryEn: Browser-native voxel sandbox engine by Fable 5.2 with infinite procedural terrain, dynamic lighting and block building.
description: 基于原生 WebGL 与 Three.js 的体素沙盒世界。拥有类似 Minecraft 的无限地形分块加载算法、柏林噪声地形生成、草地方块与岩石破坏粒子，以及实时日夜光影变化系统。
descriptionEn: A browser-native voxel sandbox powered by WebGL. Features procedural chunk-based Perlin terrain generation, block mining and placing physics, and real-time sun angle lighting.
features: 无限柏林噪声程序化地形渲染与多层 Chunk 管理
毫秒级方块破坏粒子与重力碰撞检测
快捷栏多种方块材质随心放置建造
流畅的 60 FPS 第一人称摄像机控制
featuresEn: Infinite Perlin noise chunk generation and dynamic LOD management
Sub-millisecond block fracture particles and physical collision
Quick-slot block selector for diverse architectural building
Silky smooth 60 FPS first-person controller

controls.action: 角色平移走动
第一人称视角环视
挖掘与破坏前方方块
放置当前选中的方块
切换快捷栏方块材质
跳跃攀爬

title: Hogwarts Royale · 霍格沃茨魔法吃鸡大逃杀
summary: 手持魔杖的 3D 大逃杀竞技场：毒圈不断收缩，收集全图上古魔咒与飞天扫帚，决战至最后一巫师！
summaryEn: Wand-slinging battle royale in a mystical castle courtyard: shrinking ring, ancient spell pickups, and broomstick maneuvers.
description: 结合了吃鸡竞技与魔法对决的快节奏 3D 动作游戏。玩家置身于程序化生成的古堡庭院中，躲避蔓延的魔法风暴毒圈，通过发射闪电、火焰弹、防护盾以及幻影移形消灭竞争对手，夺得魁首。
descriptionEn: Fast-paced magical battle royale created by Claude Fable 5.2. Outrun the enclosing magical mist storm, loot high-tier wands and ancient incantations, and unleash elemental spell combos to be the last wizard standing.
features: 绚丽的粒子法术弹道：烈焰咒、寒冰爆破与除你武器
经典吃鸡缩圈机制与高低差古堡立体地图
幻影移形瞬间位移与护甲咒防御机制
全 3D 角色动作与魔杖法术手势反馈
featuresEn: Brilliant elemental projectile effects: Incendio, Glacius, and Expelliarmus
Shrinking ring zone mechanic with vertical multi-tier castle layout
Apparition blink teleport and Protego shield deflection
Full 3D character kinematics with responsive wand aiming

controls.action: 战术走位与闪避
挥动魔杖发射主攻魔咒
撑开魔力护盾防御反弹
切换不同的核心魔法技能
幻影移形短距离瞬移

title: Portals: Endless Worlds · 传送门无尽异界穿梭
summary: 由沃顿商学院教授 Ethan Mollick 提示词促成：步入一道道传送门，无缝跨越数十个奇幻的程序化生成异维度。
summaryEn: Prompted by Prof. Ethan Mollick: step through glowing portals to seamlessly traverse infinite procedural dimensions.
description: 探索跨维度宇宙的沉浸式解谜漫游游戏。每一个传送门后方都隐藏着一个拥有不同几何法则、奇异重力和梦幻天空盒的异世界，玩家在各个世界之间寻找时空锚点并解开古老机关。
descriptionEn: An atmospheric dimensional exploration puzzle crafted by Fable 5.2. Each portal door opens directly into an exotic biome with unique geometry, gravity constants, and surreal skyboxes.
features: 无缝非欧几里得传送门视锥渲染技术
数十种差异极大的程序化生态宇宙空间
结合环境重力变化的解谜机制
空灵的程序化合成氛围音乐
featuresEn: Seamless non-Euclidean portal view rendering in pure WebGL
Dozens of contrasting procedural dimensional realms
Gravity-shifting environmental spatial puzzles
Ethereal procedural ambient audio score

controls.action: 角色漫步移动
转动视线观察传送门内外
激活时空锚点与机关交互
失重跳跃与漂浮

title: I Would Have Gotten Away · 逆向解谜捉迷藏侦探
titleEn: I Would Have Gotten Away With It
summary: 经典史酷比侦探剧的反转：这次你扮演幽灵反派，必须在爱管闲事的小分队揭露真相前精心布置机关！
summaryEn: Scooby-Doo mystery turned upside down: play the haunted villain and orchestrate traps before the sleuths unmask you!
description: 充满幽默感的美式复古卡通逆向潜行策略游戏。玩家扮演假扮幽灵的大亨，在古堡各处布置升降滑索、干冰烟雾与机械怪物，吓跑侦探小队，并在被当场抓获前成功逃之夭夭。
descriptionEn: A clever comic stealth strategy game by Ethan Mollick & Fable 5.2. Flipping classic cartoon tropes, you play the masked culprit rigging traps, creating fake paranormal hoaxes, and dodging meddling kids.
features: 颠覆传统的反派视角策略布防玩法
经典美式复古卡通艺术风格与幽默音效
丰富的机关道具：投影仪、滑轮索道与假门
充满变数的侦探 AI 行为树巡逻逻辑
featuresEn: Fresh villain-perspective strategic stealth gameplay
Retro Saturday-morning cartoon visual aesthetic and comic SFX
Rich inventory of hoax tools: holograms, zip-lines, and trapdoors
Dynamic AI behavior trees guiding the meddling detectives

title: What the Water Keeps · 水之秘境深渊叙事冒险
titleEn: What the Water Keeps: Deep Narrative
summary: Kevin Ngo 潜心打造的深水互动艺术之作：在幽暗水域潜行，打捞沉睡在深渊之底的记忆回响。
summaryEn: A haunting poetic dive created by Kevin Ngo: delve into murky ocean depths to dredge up buried memories.
description: 极具电影感的水下探险叙事游戏。游戏采用独特的深海水色渲染与流动光斑滤镜，伴随柔和的潜水呼吸声，玩家操控探测仪器在水下残骸间搜寻遗落的录音带与历史碎片，揭开一段隐秘过往。
descriptionEn: A cinematic underwater interactive journey crafted by Kevin Ngo through Claude Fable 5.2. Features procedural fluid light refraction, submerged hydrophone audio, and an evocative mystery narrative.
features: 极致唯美的水下焦散与深海悬浮微粒渲染
电影级环境水声设计与沉浸式动态音景
深度剧情互动与多重隐喻结局分支
细腻的潜水声呐与打捞工具交互
featuresEn: Stunning underwater caustic refraction and suspended marine snow particles
Binaural underwater hydrophone soundscapes and dynamic audio
Evocative branched narrative with multiple thematic conclusions
Tactile sonar ping and underwater salvage mechanics

controls.action: 潜水艇 / 潜水员水下平滑游动
发射声呐脉冲扫描水底残骸
调查沉船遗物并倾听回忆
上浮浮潜 / 下潜深海

title: Turbo Tails · 涡轮尾迹狂飙竞速
summary: 由 Peter Yang 制作的超爽快 3D 街机竞速：喷射彩色粒子尾迹，在弯道连续极限漂移蓄满氮气！
summaryEn: High-octane arcade 3D racer by Peter Yang: leave vibrant particle trails and chain corner drifts for nitrous.
description: 极具速度感的 3D 原生 WebGL 赛车游戏。继承了经典世嘉街机风格的狂暴驾驶手感，车轮带有抓地力滑移曲线与粒子胎痕，在城市夜景高速公路与山路大回环中争夺极速第一名。
descriptionEn: A thrill-fueled 3D browser racer created by Peter Yang with Claude Fable 5.2. Channelling vintage Sega arcade physics, complete with drift slip angles, tire smoke particles, and explosive nitrous boosts.
features: 街机级爽快漂移力学与多段氮气喷射机制
绚丽的霓虹光带尾迹与动态速度线特效
程序化生成的立交桥与发卡弯竞速赛道
多款性能各异的酷炫街车随心驾驭
featuresEn: Arcade-calibrated drift handling with tiered nitro boost gauges
Luminescent neon tail-light ribbons and dynamic motion blur lines
Procedural overpass highways and hair-raising hairpin loops
Multiple tuned sports cars with responsive suspension kinematics

title: Childhood Rug Racer · 地毯童年小汽车怀旧竞速
summary: 让全世界网友瞬间泪目的创意之作：在小时候房间里印着道路和房屋的经典交通游戏地毯上开车！
summaryEn: Whimsical nostalgia trip: pilot micro toy cars directly across the iconic childhood city traffic play rug!
description: Noclipepe 运用 Fable 5.2 唤醒所有人童年记忆的温馨作品。将小时候几乎人手一张的经典儿童交通道路游戏地毯高精建模为 3D 赛道，操作小玩具车在印有医院、警察局和小桥的毛绒地毯上欢快奔跑。
descriptionEn: A heartwarming nostalgic hit created by Noclipepe via Fable 5.2. Faithfully reconstructs the legendary childhood city-street play mat into an interactive micro-scale 3D playground with delightful toy car physics.
features: 完美还原经典儿童房城市道路图案地毯高保真材质
逼真有趣的微型合金玩具小车弹簧悬挂物理
各种地毯上的玩具方块障碍物与斜坡飞车
充满童趣的玩具喇叭鸣笛音效
featuresEn: Faithful micro-scale textile shader reproducing the iconic city road rug
Playful springy toy vehicle suspension and bouncing dynamics
Toy brick ramps, obstacle blocks and carpet folds to leap across
Charming toy car horn honks and rolling carpet SFX

title: Rambo Dino · 兰博恐龙热血横版街机扫射
summary: 一只身绑红色头巾、手提重型加特林机枪的霸王龙横扫战场，重温合金弹头般的爽快突突突！
summaryEn: A red-bandana T-Rex packing a heavy Gatling gun: relive the classic Metal Slug arcade run-and-gun ecstasy!
description: 由 Noclipepe 借助 Fable 5.2 打造的硬派横版射击动作游戏。玩家扮演武装到牙齿的恐龙战士兰博，在枪林弹雨中跳跃躲闪，发射火箭筒与全屏弹幕，将敌方机械军团碾成废铁。
descriptionEn: An explosive retro run-and-gun side-scroller created by Noclipepe with Claude Fable 5.2. Take command of an unstoppable heavily-armed Rambo dinosaur blazing through swarms of mechanical enemies.
features: 经典合金弹头式的硬核横版平台跳跃射击
加特林重机枪、散弹枪与核能火箭筒丰富武器库
极具打击感的像素爆炸与击飞物理反馈
动感十足的 16-bit 街机电音配乐
featuresEn: Pure Metal-Slug-inspired 2D run-and-gun combat mechanics
Arsenal featuring Gatlings, spread shotguns, and tactical RPGs
Juicy pixel particle explosions and screen shake impact
High-energy 16-bit chiptune arcade soundtrack

controls.action: 霸王龙左右突进奔跑
向上瞄准射击 / 平台跳跃
重机枪疯狂倾泻弹药
投掷高爆破片手雷

title: Frontline Warfare · 前线战争殊死对决
summary: 沉浸式 3D 团队死斗对抗：在饱受炮火洗礼的工业阵地穿梭，依靠战术掩体与精准点射击退敌军。
summaryEn: Tactical 3D team deathmatch arena: maneuver through war-torn industrial frontlines using cover and precise marksmanship.
description: 由 alightinastorm 创作的拟真军事风格网页第一人称对抗射击。具有完善的掩体规避系统、兵种射程判定与后坐力抑制机制，带给玩家纯粹的战场交火压迫感。
descriptionEn: A gritty military-style FPS built by alightinastorm using Claude Fable 5.2. Delivers authentic combat adrenaline with physical bullet ballistics, dynamic cover mechanics, and intelligent tactical AI squads.
features: 真实的弹道下坠计算与精确头部爆头伤害倍率
复杂掩体交互系统与战术滑铲位移
动态战况计分板与智能人机战术小队
多武器切换：突击步枪、战术手枪与狙击长枪
featuresEn: Realistic ballistic drop and lethal headshot damage multipliers
Fluid cover mounting and tactical crouch slide mechanics
Dynamic battle scoreboard with intelligent squad combat AI
Multi-weapon loadouts: assault rifles, sidearms, and marksman rifles

controls.action: 战术走位与阵地转移
准星精确指向
开火射击
机瞄精确瞄准
更换战术弹匣
下蹲寻找沙袋掩体

title: Feed the Backrooms · 喂养后室恐怖逃脱
summary: 迷失在无限泛黄墙纸与日光灯蜂鸣声的'后室'中，收集祭品喂养游荡的潜伏实体，寻找逃出生天的出口！
summaryEn: Lost in the infinite mono-yellow hallways of the Backrooms: collect sacrifices to appease entities and find the exit!
description: LexnLin 借助 Claude Fable 5.2 精准复刻后室（The Backrooms）精神内核的恐怖生存解谜游戏。潮湿的地毯、闪烁滋滋作响的荧光灯、拐角处突然响起的未知脚步声，为你带来身临其境的心理恐惧体验。
descriptionEn: A chilling survival horror experience by LexnLin via Claude Fable 5.2. Recreates the iconic liminal dread of The Backrooms: buzzing fluorescent tubes, damp carpets, and terrifying spatial entities tracking your scent.
features: 经典 Level 0 无限黄色迷宫程序化生成地图
基于音源传播的实体感知与追踪 AI
有限电量手电筒与生存理智值（Sanity）管理
高压环境下的潜行搜集与献祭解密机制
featuresEn: Infinite Level 0 mono-yellow procedural labyrinth architecture
Acoustic hearing perception and tracking algorithms for entities
Flickering battery flashlight and sanity management meter
High-tension stealth scavenging and sacrifice altar progression

controls.action: 轻手轻脚在走廊走动
晃动手电筒探照四周
开关手电筒以节约电量
捡起地面补给品或献祭物品
听到异响时全力冲刺逃跑

title: Cloud Stunt 3D · 云端特技飞行竞速
summary: 驾驶高机动特技单翼机在壮阔云海穿行：穿越浮空光环，完成桶滚与失速俯冲挑战极速纪录！
summaryEn: Pilot an agile stunt monoplane through breathtaking cloudscapes: thread mid-air rings and pull barrel rolls for records!
description: 极具自由度的 3D 特技飞行模拟游戏。借助原生 WebGL 的体积云雾着色器，玩家在蓝天白云与悬浮群岛之间翱翔，拥有完整的 6 自由度空气动力学俯仰、滚转与偏航操控手感。
descriptionEn: An exhilarating 3D flight aerobatics game built with Claude Fable 5.2. Features 6DOF aerodynamic physics, volumetric cloud shaders, floating sky island checkpoints, and responsive throttle control.
features: 纯 WebGL 体积云海光影着色与高空穿云效果
逼真的空气动力学升力、失速与重力过载手感
连贯的空中穿越光环计时赛与高难度特技积分
平滑的第三人称飞行跟随机位与驾驶舱内视角切换
featuresEn: Pure WebGL volumetric cloudscape shaders with dynamic sky scattering
Aerodynamic lift, drag, stall limits, and G-force flight kinematics
Time-attack ring-threading circuits and acrobatic stunt trick combos
Seamless toggle between chase chase-cam and cockpit view

加力推力全开加速
切换座舱/机尾摄影机视角

title: Worm Rider · 沙虫骑手沙漠冒险
summary: 致敬《沙丘》的史诗级沙漠狂飙：召唤并驾驭百米长的远古巨型沙虫，在漫天黄沙中穿梭征服荒原！
summaryEn: Epic desert odyssey inspired by Dune: summon and ride a hundred-meter ancient sandworm across roaring sand seas!
description: AmirMushich 借助 Fable 5.2 实现的视觉奇迹。通过反向运动学（IK）实时模拟多节沙虫身躯在沙丘起伏中的波浪形穿梭，扬起漫天沙尘，震撼的沙暴粒子与震耳欲聋的地底轰鸣令人热血沸腾。
descriptionEn: A breathtaking desert riding simulation crafted by AmirMushich using Fable 5.2. Features procedural multi-segment inverse kinematics (IK) animating a massive sandworm cresting sand dunes amid blinding dust storms.
features: 程序化多节段身体反向运动学（IK）动态摆动
浩瀚无垠的流体沙丘物理与狂暴沙暴粒子系统
驾驭钩爪控制沙虫转向与破沙飞跃
震撼的 WebAudio 低频地底生物轰鸣声效
featuresEn: Procedural multi-segmented inverse kinematics (IK) spine animation
Endless desert dunes with real-time fluid particle sandstorms
Maker hooks steering mechanics: breach sand dunes and dive deep
Deep sub-bass synthesized earth tremor acoustics

借力沙丘腾空飞跃沙海
从骑手高空视角俯瞰荒漠

title: Roost · 泥地越野摩托冲刺
summary: 轰鸣的二冲程引擎与泥浆四溅的越野赛道：驾驭轻量级越野摩托，在起伏土坡完成超高难度的腾空翻转！
summaryEn: Screaming two-stroke engines and roosting mud: control a lightweight dirt bike across rugged dirt jumps and air flips!
description: 极具挑战性的 3D 物理越野摩托特技游戏。物理引擎真实计算了前后避震器的压缩回弹阻尼与骑手重心转移，在泥泞起伏的越野赛道上飞驰，稍有不慎便会车翻人仰。
descriptionEn: A physics-intensive motocross trial game crafted by Tejas with Claude Fable 5.2. Accurately simulates dual-suspension dampening, rider weight transfer, mud roost spray, and high-flying aerial flips.
features: 独立前后轮悬挂弹簧物理与地面附着力模拟
空中姿态重心微调与 360 度前后空翻特技
飞溅泥土颗粒与泥泞抓地痕迹实时渲染
狂暴逼真的单缸摩托引擎排气声浪
featuresEn: Independent front/rear suspension spring dampening and tire friction
Mid-air rider center-of-mass pitch control for 360 front/backflips
Roost particle spray and dynamic mud groove surface deformation
Raw high-revving 2-stroke exhaust audio simulation

controls.action: 大拧油门向前爆冲
重刹后轮防止冲出赛道
空中前后倾斜调整骑手重心
弹射离合器暴力起步

title: Stray Cat · 流浪猫城市模拟
summary: 化身一只敏捷小猫穿梭在现代都市的屋顶与小巷：跳上空调外机、打翻桌上水杯，享受悠闲猫生！
summaryEn: Become an agile kitten exploring city rooftops and alleys: leap onto AC units, knock cups over, and enjoy feline life!
description: Aimikoda 借助 Fable 5.2 带来的温暖治愈之作。你是一只在城市里自由漫步的小橘猫，拥有流畅优雅的四足奔跑动画、抓挠地毯、喵喵叫与高难度墙檐轻功跳跃能力，用猫咪的独特视角重新打量人类世界。
descriptionEn: A heartwarming urban adventure created by Aimikoda via Claude Fable 5.2. Roam freely as a nimble ginger cat across balconies, gutters, and back alleys with lifelike paw kinematics, playful mischief, and cozy meows.
features: 细腻逼真的猫咪四足步态与空中翻身稳当落地系统
生动的猫咪专属互动：打翻花盆、蹭路人裤腿、猫爪抓沙发
垂直立体的都市探索：管道、晾衣架与铁丝网穿行
一键发出萌力十足的清脆猫叫
featuresEn: Graceful procedural quadruped locomotion and feline righting reflex
Playful cat interactions: swatting mugs, scratching poles, and naps
Vertical urban exploration spanning drainpipes, canopies, and ledges
Dedicated button to chirp and meow with procedural pitch variations

controls.action: 猫爪轻盈跑动跳跃
小猫灵动视角环视
敏捷跃上高墙与空调外机
伸出爪子推下边缘物品
奶声奶气喵喵叫

title: Tilt Labyrinth · 重力倾斜迷宫
summary: 经典物理木盘滚珠桌游重现：倾斜盘面控制钢珠精准避开密密麻麻的深坑陷阱，平稳滚入终点星标！
summaryEn: Classic wooden tilt-board puzzle re-engineered: tilt the table to guide a polished steel ball around treacherous pitfalls!
description: 极具真实质感的 3D 物理平衡解谜小游戏。钢珠在木纹盘面上滑动时拥有真实的重力加速度、壁面弹性碰撞以及令人极度解压的滚珠滚轴音效，考验玩家极具耐心的微操掌控力。
descriptionEn: A satisfying, tactile 3D physical marble maze created by Mylifcc with Fable 5.2. Recreates the timeless analog tabletop toy with sub-pixel collision physics, authentic rolling wood rumble, and tricky trap holes.
features: 超逼真的刚体动力学与球面滚动摩擦力计算
精细的清漆原木材质与金属光泽反光着色
支持鼠标平滑拖拽倾斜与键盘微调双操作模式
多个精心设计的复杂迷宫关卡挑战
featuresEn: Rigid-body mechanics calculating angular velocity and sphere friction
Detailed varnished mahogany wood and shiny chrome sphere shaders
Dual control options: analog mouse drag tilt or keyboard micro-adjust
Dozens of hand-crafted ascending difficulty maze layouts

controls.action: 按住鼠标平滑倾斜木质迷宫盘面

title: Silicon Seduction · 硅基诱惑黑客RPG
summary: 霓虹雨夜下的赛博朋克黑客角色扮演：潜入巨型财阀核心数据库，在道德边缘抉择人类与 AI 的未来！
summaryEn: Cyberpunk noir role-playing in a neon rain cityscape: breach megacorp mainframes and decide the fate of humanity and AI!
description: ZryMiller 构思的赛博朋克叙事 RPG。游戏融合了终端命令行代码入侵小游戏、分支丰富的深层剧情对话以及霓虹交织的暗色调界面，你的每一次选择都在改写地下黑客帝国的权力格局。
descriptionEn: A neon-soaked cyberpunk narrative RPG built by ZryMiller via Claude Fable 5.2. Combines interactive terminal hacking mini-games with deep philosophical dialogue trees and fateful moral crossroads.
features: 扣人心弦的深度科幻剧情与多结局走向
终端命令行破解解谜与节点防火墙绕过机制
高度风格化的赛博朋克霓虹终端视觉美学
合成波电子乐与机械键盘按键击打音效
featuresEn: Gripping speculative sci-fi storyline featuring multiple ending states
Interactive terminal bypass and cybersecurity puzzle nodes
Stylized CRT scanline cyber-terminal visual design
Immersive synthwave soundtrack paired with mechanical key-clatter audio

controls.action: 选择剧情对话与行动分支
在黑客终端输入指令破解密码
切换背包植入体与系统菜单

title: Vippi · 极简霓虹快节奏射击
summary: 灵感源自经典几何战争的快节奏竞技场射击：纯黑背景与璀璨发光霓虹线框，在密集弹幕中瞬间闪避消灭敌人！
summaryEn: Hyper-kinetic neon vector arena shooter: glide across a pitch-black abyss blasting geometric invaders with lasers!
description: Shrit1401 带来的极速节奏射击体验。游戏采用纯粹的高亮发光线框视觉风格，玩家驾驶灵活的几何飞行器，在四面八方涌来的多边形蜂群中穿梭漂移，连续击杀触发绚丽的粒子冲击波。
descriptionEn: A lightning-fast vector arcade shooter by Shrit1401 coded by Claude Fable 5.2. Channels Geometry Wars aesthetics with ultra-responsive inertia physics, screen-clearing pulse bombs, and kaleidoscopic bloom explosions.
features: 极其顺滑的 120 FPS 响应手感与惯性滑移漂移
发光泛光（Bloom）几何线条与绚烂的爆炸粒子
多样化的几何敌人：追踪菱形、自爆三角与巨型母舰
节奏强劲的电子合成节拍卡点打击反馈
featuresEn: Silky 120 FPS responsive controls with momentum-based sliding drift
Hyper-saturated vector bloom line graphics and particle shockwaves
Diverse geometric enemies: homing diamonds, suicide triangles, and motherships
High-tempo beat-synced hit confirms and acoustic pulse synth

controls.action: 飞行器惯性滑行机动
360 度全向武器瞄准
高速连射脉冲激光
释放全屏清屏冲击波护盾

title: Four-character Fight · 声控格斗四字乱斗
summary: 由 Promoden Studio 打造的硬派 2D 街机格斗：四位身怀绝技的武术宗师，支持经典按键搓招与连击必杀！
summaryEn: Hard-hitting 2D arcade fighter by Promoden: four legendary masters clashing with combo inputs and super specials!
description: 致敬街霸与拳皇的复古街机格斗游戏。拥有完整的受击硬直、格挡减伤、浮空追击与下前拳（波动拳）等经典格斗指令输入系统，每一拳每一腿都充满拳拳到肉的打击感。
descriptionEn: A classic retro arcade 2D fighting game crafted with Claude Fable 5.2. Boasts authentic frame data, hit-stun timings, block dampening, aerial juggles, and quarter-circle command inputs for signature specials.
features: 严谨的格斗判定框（Hitbox/Hurtbox）与连段取消机制
四大特色迥异的格斗宗师与专属必杀技大招
经典的波动拳、升龙拳与全屏超必杀炫酷立绘
支持键盘双人同屏对战与智能 AI 单人街机闯关
featuresEn: Authentic fighting game frame data, hitboxes, and special cancels
Four distinct martial arts characters with unique special move sets
Iconic Hadouken and Shoryuken command gestures with super portraits
Supports 2-player local keyboard battle and arcade ladder AI

controls.action: 角色前后走位与后退格挡
跳跃腾空 / 下蹲防守
轻拳 / 重脚攻击
特殊技与超必杀释放

title: VOWLORN · 破誓者全代码奇幻RPG
summary: Higgsfield 团队全网刷屏的里程碑之作：100% 纯代码由 Fable 5.2 生成，深度暗黑奇幻地下城冒险与装备构筑！
summaryEn: Viral landmark by Higgsfield: 100% pure code generated by Fable 5.2 featuring dark fantasy dungeon crawling and deep loot builds!
description: 这是被 Higgsfield 官方长文专门报道的 AI 独立游戏奇迹。Fable 5.2 从零写就了完整的程序化暗黑地下城生成器、怪物战斗 AI、属性天赋树、战利品掉落与随机词条附魔系统，带来无比沉浸的硬核 RPG 体验。
descriptionEn: A viral breakthrough extensively documented by Higgsfield Studio. Fable 5.2 engineered procedural dungeon generation, monster behavior AI, skill perk trees, and randomized affix loot mechanics entirely from scratch.
features: 程序化暗黑地牢迷宫生成与战争迷雾系统
深度装备 Build 搭配：传奇武器、套装效果与符文镶嵌
硬核实时动作战斗：翻滚躲闪、法术吟唱与体力值管理
史诗级暗黑哥特氛围美术与沉浸式中世纪原声配乐
featuresEn: Procedural multi-level gothic dungeon layouts with dynamic fog-of-war
Deep ARPG loot system: legendary gear, set synergies, and socketed gems
Challenging real-time combat with stamina metering, dodges, and spellcasting
Haunting dark fantasy art direction and sweeping medieval ambient score

controls.action: 地牢探索与战术走位
主手武器挥击攻击
举盾格挡或施展副手法术
快速翻滚躲避致命攻击
释放高阶奥术与治疗药水
打开装备背包与人物属性面板

title: Oil Paint · 油画质感沉浸探索
summary: 宛如漫步在印象派大师画布之中的艺术游戏：厚涂油彩笔触随微风起伏，探寻画布背后的生命诗篇！
summaryEn: Step inside a living impressionist oil painting: thick expressive brushstrokes sway gently as you uncover painted secrets!
description: BlendiByl 借助 Fable 5.2 开发的艺术风格探索冒险。利用独特的自定义着色器将整个 3D 场景渲染为充满触感质地的厚涂油画，一草一木、光影折射均带有画笔涂抹的肌理感，让人流连忘返。
descriptionEn: A painterly art adventure created by BlendiByl using Claude Fable 5.2. Employs a custom post-processing shader stack that transforms 3D geometry into tangible impressionist impasto oil brushstrokes.
features: 令人惊叹的程序化油画笔触肌理与色彩混色着色器
风吹麦浪与树影摇曳的动态画布呼吸效果
寻找遗失的画笔颜料解锁场景隐藏区域
优雅宁静的古典弦乐背景旋律
featuresEn: Custom impasto paint stroke post-fx pipeline with pigment blending
Breathing world dynamics: wind ripples through textured canvas grass
Scavenge lost pigment tubes to restore color to dimmed vistas
Tranquil classical violin and cello soundtrack

controls.action: 在如画的美景中漫步探索
全景欣赏油画笔触光影
采集画中颜料与色彩交互
轻盈跳跃越过画中溪流

title: CROSSTOWN · 纽约开放世界极速穿行
summary: Matt Shumer 轰动推特的'7天挑战'巨制：程序化纽约曼哈顿高楼林立，在车流穿梭中体验次世代开放都市！
summaryEn: Matt Shumer's viral open-world epic: towering Manhattan skyscrapers, traffic simulation, and urban traversal built in days!
description: 「Rockstar 花了 8 年制作 GTA，Fable 5.2 正在用几天时间证明未来」。Matt Shumer 借助 Fable 5.2 构建的纽约开放世界早期演示，拥有摩天大楼天际线、街道车流碰撞、多建筑进出和极速奔跑穿梭机制，备受行业瞩目。
descriptionEn: A viral marvel by Matt Shumer: 'Rockstar took 8 years, Fable 5.2 is doing this in days.' Explore Manhattan's dense urban grid, hop into cruising sports cars, weave through traffic, and test early mechanics.
features: 高度还原的纽约曼哈顿网格化街区与摩天大楼天际线
车辆驾驶物理系统与智能城市交通车流 AI
高楼攀爬跳跃与极速街道跑酷穿梭体验
实时按键（B 键）向开发者提交改进反馈
featuresEn: Dense Manhattan grid architecture with towering skyscraper skylines
Dynamic vehicle handling kinematics and urban traffic AI routines
Rooftop parkour traversal and seamless on-foot urban sprint
Integrated real-time player telemetry feedback hotkey (B key)

进入或离开道路上的载具

打开实时反馈面板提交建议

title: Evensong · 暮歌暗黑魂系地牢
summary: Kevin Ngo 倾力打磨的硬核魂系动作神作：点燃幽暗营火，精准弹反首领重击，在绝望中寻找破晓微光！
summaryEn: Hardcore Souls-like action crafted by Kevin Ngo: kindle bonfires, master precise parries, and fell colossal bosses!
description: 具有纯正魂系血统的 3D 动作冒险游戏。拥有严苛的精力条（Stamina）管理、带有无敌帧的翻滚闪避、致命弹反处决与多阶段首领战，在残垣断壁与幽暗地牢中体验步步惊心的死斗。
descriptionEn: A punishing 3D souls-like action challenge by Kevin Ngo via Claude Fable 5.2. Demands strict stamina discipline, iframe dodge rolls, high-risk parry counters, and multi-phase epic boss encounters.
features: 经典魂味营火存盘点与怪物刷新机制
精准判定窗口的盾反处决与断肢破韧系统
气势磅礴的多阶段守门首领 AI 动作模组
暗黑中世纪废墟与逼真火把动态光影
featuresEn: Authentic bonfire checkpoint mechanics and realm-reset loops
Strict timing-window parry ripostes and poise-breaking staggered hits
Formidable multi-phase guardian boss AI with deadly telegraphs
Atmospheric dark gothic ruin environments with dynamic torchlight

controls.action: 沉稳走位控制战斗距离
普通斩击与轻武器连招
盾牌格挡或精准弹反
翻滚闪避利用无敌帧化解重击
饮用原素瓶恢复生命值

title: Gilt & Gutter · 镀金与阴沟黑帮巷战
summary: 1940 年代黑白诺瓦尔黑色电影风格：在雨夜迷离的罪恶小巷中，手持汤姆逊冲锋枪展开殊死对决！
summaryEn: 1940s vintage film noir crime drama: duel syndicate mobsters in rain-soaked back alleys with classic Tommy guns!
description: Kevin Ngo 带来的高风格化黑色电影动作射击。黑白高对比度光影、被雨水打湿的反光沥青路面、路灯下的长长倒影，搭配爵士乐与雷雨声，为玩家带来身临其境的老式黑帮警匪大片体验。
descriptionEn: A stylish film-noir cover shooter by Kevin Ngo using Fable 5.2. Immerses players in high-contrast monochrome cinematography, wet asphalt reflections, moody neon glows, and vintage Tommy gun firefights.
features: 老式黑色电影胶片颗粒感与高对比度光影滤镜
掩体射击系统：翻越垃圾桶与防火梯躲避弹雨
经典 1940 年代枪械：左轮手枪、泵动式猎枪与冲锋枪
忧郁醉人的爵士萨克斯与倾盆暴雨环境音效
featuresEn: Grainy 35mm film noir post-processing with high-contrast chiaroscuro
Dynamic cover mechanic: duck behind brick dumpsters and fire escapes
Period-accurate 1940s firearms: snubbies, pump shotguns, and Tommy guns
Melancholic jazz saxophone solos woven with driving rain foley

controls.action: 在阴暗巷道中谨慎穿行

举枪精细瞄准

填装弹药弹鼓

title: LANTERNFALL · 提灯骤降暗影生存
summary: Loktar00 呈现的幽闭暗影生存神作：提灯是你唯一的生命依托，在无尽黑夜中添油续命，躲避阴影生物！
summaryEn: A chilling dungeon descent by Loktar00: your oil lantern is your only lifeline; keep the flame fed to ward off shadows!
description: 以光与影为核心机制的暗影生存探索游戏。地底深渊中潜伏着吞噬光芒的暗影怪兽，提灯的油量正在一分一秒流逝。收集散落的煤油瓶与发光水晶，点亮远古符文祭坛方能驱散深沉黑暗。
descriptionEn: A tension-soaked survival horror experience by Loktar00 powered by Claude Fable 5.2. Darkness isn't just absence of light—it's a living entity. Manage your dwindling lantern oil to keep lurking beasts at bay.
features: 动态光锥与暗影迷雾体积渲染系统
提灯煤油消耗与火焰强弱动态影响可视范围
对光线敏感的潜伏阴影生物 AI 生态
地下遗迹古老谜题与祭坛点燃机制
featuresEn: Dynamic volumetric light cone and creeping shadow fog rendering
Lantern fuel decay affecting sight radius and monster aggression
Light-averse predatory shadow creature behavioral ecology
Subterranean environmental puzzles and sanctuary braziers

controls.action: 小心翼翼在黑暗迷宫中前行
举起提灯照射探索方向
给提灯补充煤油续火
搜集矿灯与点亮壁上火把

title: Rooftop Rally · 屋顶匹克球竞技
summary: 在摩天大楼天台打当下最火爆的匹克球！精准切球、强力扣杀，在开阔云海全景下与强劲 AI 争夺天台球王！
summaryEn: Play high-stakes pickleball on skyscraper rooftops! Master drop shots, kitchen volleys, and smashes above the clouds!
description: 由知名开发者 Chongdashu 运用 Fable 5.2 制作的趣味高空体育竞技游戏。将当下风靡全球的匹克球搬到了摩天大楼的屋顶球场，逼真的击球物理、清脆的球拍击打声和多变的风向让每一局对拉都充满乐趣。
descriptionEn: An energetic sports arcade hit crafted by Chongdashu via Claude Fable 5.2. Brings the worldwide pickleball phenomenon to breathtaking high-altitude rooftop courts with authentic paddle pop and spin acoustics.
features: 严格遵循匹克球非截击区（厨房区）发球与落点规则
逼真的旋转球空气动力学与球拍接触角度弹射
俯瞰摩天大楼全景的壮阔天台视觉舞台
多难度自适应球路预测 AI 对手
featuresEn: Faithful implementation of pickleball 'kitchen' non-volley zone rules
Realistic ball spin aerodynamic curves and paddle face trajectory deflection
Spectacular panoramic high-rise skyline court backdrop
Adaptive multi-tier AI opponent capable of defensive dinks and smashes

controls.action: 底线左右横向移动就位

title: Dread & District · 恐惧街区悬疑解谜
summary: 穿行在雾气弥漫的维多利亚式老街区：搜集散落物证、破解机关锁扣，拼凑出隐藏在黑夜背后的惊人谜案！
summaryEn: Navigate fog-shrouded Victorian alleys: discover clues, decipher antique lockboxes, and solve a chilling urban mystery!

精巧的机械密码锁、暗门与机关盒解谜设计

Intricate physical lockbox puzzles, hidden levers, and cipher decoders
Detective case notebook indexing evidence threads and deductions
Engrossing mystery plotline with unexpected story revelations

行云流水的武侠剑术连招、御剑飞天与破招击飞
气势磅礴的仙侠云海、青石山门与落叶飘零特效
国风古筝与琵琶激昂交织的战斗背景音乐

title: The Waking River · 苏醒之河唯美漂流之旅
summary: 乘一叶扁舟顺流而下：倾听两岸潺潺流水与鸟鸣，在晨曦与星光交替间体验一场洗涤心灵的唯美漂流。
summaryEn: Drift down a tranquil river on a gentle wooden canoe: take in morning mists, riverside wildlife, and shimmering waters.

descriptionEn: A meditative atmospheric river journey by flxrnc created with Claude Fable 5.2. Features fluid buoyancy physics carrying a small wooden canoe through procedurally shifting biomes under gentle day-to-night transitions.

随时间流转的动态昼夜循环天光与水面反光
两岸野生动物与生机盎然的自然生态环境
极其解压的高保真自然水流声与环境白噪音
featuresEn: Gentle procedural water wave shaders paired with buoyant hull physics
Dynamic day-night lighting cycles reflecting off the peaceful surface
Procedural riverbanks populated with lush flora and wildlife
Calming binaural stream foley and soothing organic nature soundscapes

日系轻小说般明亮温暖的手绘画风与界面排版
多种截然不同的人生结局与甜蜜隐藏彩蛋

Warm watercolor-inspired visual presentation and typography

summary: Ebbyamir 打造的 Synthwave 赛博巡航：驾驶改装跑车穿行在紫金色调的星空高速，沉醉于合成器电音！

Dynamic vehicle chassis roll, neon underglow, and reflective paint

Immersive cockpit first-person dashboard camera option
